products.name: Cameron Highlands Tomatoes
products.description: Vine-ripened tomatoes grown in the cool Cameron Highlands, picked the same morning they are listed. Grown with minimal spray.

products.name: Musang King Durian — Pre-order
products.description: Reserve premium D197 Musang King from our Raub orchard. Tree-dropped, graded, and delivered within 24 hours of harvest.

products.name: Weekly Sayur Box
products.description: A rotating weekly box of 8–10 seasonal vegetables and herbs from our community farm. Pause or skip any week. Includes simple resepi cards.

products.name: Raw Kelulut Honey
products.description: Tangy-sweet raw kelulut (stingless bee) honey, harvested and jarred without heating. Single-origin from our Kelantan apiary.

products.name: Bulk Chilli (Cili Merah)
products.description: Restaurant-grade red chilli, graded and packed. Volume pricing available — request a quote for your quantity and we reply same-day.

products.name: Kampung Chicken Eggs
products.description: Eggs from free-roaming kampung hens, collected every morning. Deep golden yolks.

products.name: Harumanis Mango — Pre-order
products.description: Reserve a box of the famous Perlis Harumanis — fragrant, honey-sweet mangoes. First-pick fruit, hand-sorted.

products.name: Bulk Red Onions (Bawang)
products.description: Cured storage onions with consistent sizing for prep kitchens. Volume pricing by quote.

products.name: Beras Wangi Rice Share
products.description: A monthly 5kg bag of fragrant rice, milled to order from our Sekinchan paddy fields. Fresher than anything on the shelf.

products.name: Fresh Herbs (Daun Kesum)
products.description: Aromatic Vietnamese mint (daun kesum) and mixed local herbs, cut to order the morning of pickup or delivery.
